messages:
Mia (support): FYI — ACME Corp (EU) submitted a DPA erasure for org `acme-2222`. They want: deletion proof for user embeddings & logs, confirmation on KMS/HSM key handling, and a copy of sub-processor list. They also hit a 500 on `DELETE /v1/customers/acme-2222/data` and saw unexpected billing line items after the request. Escalating.
Sam (eng): thanks — can you paste the request payload and the DELETE trace id?
Mia (support): trace id `tr-202603121015-ACME-9`. Payload was just { "scope": "all", "requester": "admin@acme.com" }. Customer says DELETE returned 500 then retried and got 202, but charges appeared in the next invoice snapshot.
Alex (security): pinging here. First things to check: (1) audit logs for deletion job, (2) KMS key status for customer's wrapped keys, (3) any background retry that reprocessed tokens causing billing.
Sam (eng): repro steps I ran locally (eu-west-1):
```
# reproduce customer delete call
curl -i -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/customers/acme-2222/data" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"scope":"all","requester":"admin@acme.com"}'
```
Result for me: first call returned `500` with body `{"error":"kms:access denied"}`, second immediate retry returned `202`.
Mia (support): customer screenshot shows `500` message `internal server error - deletion job failed to acquire key` and an invoice diff with `storage:embeddings:ingest` entries 2 hours after their request.
Alex (security): likely root cause: KMS transient auth error triggered job to exit and then a retry worker re-ingested some queued tasks. Steps: verify KMS key state and HSM logs, and produce deletion audit bundle. I can pull HSM logs but need the exact key id.
Mia (support): key id from customer metadata: `rw-kms-eu-742a` (derived). Passing to you @Alex.
Alex (security): grabbing HSM/KMS logs now. Typical checks: `KeyState` (Active | PendingDeletion | Disabled), and any `Decrypt/Encrypt` error at ~2026-03-12T10:15:xxZ. Also check KMS conditional access events from our connector.
Sam (eng): meanwhile check storage: run this query in logs service to capture deletion job and retries:
```
service:ingest AND event:deletion AND org:acme-2222 | sort @timestamp asc | filter job_id:del-*
```
Snippet I see:
```
[2026-03-12T10:15:22Z] INFO deletion: started job id=del-789 user=system target=embeddings bucket=eu-west-1
[2026-03-12T10:15:23Z] ERROR deletion: kms_decrypt failed key=rw-kms-eu-742a err="access denied"
[2026-03-12T10:15:25Z] WARN deletion: job aborted, enqueued retry job=del-789-retry
[2026-03-12T10:17:30Z] INFO ingest: reprocess job id=ingest-234 for org=acme-2222 items=14
```
Looks like retry caused re-ingest of ~14 items. That explains billing.
Leah (legal): we need to provide the customer a DPA-compliant erasure report within 72 hours. That must include: evidence bundle (audit logs showing deletion start/complete per object), KMS key audit (no material retained, or exact action if scheduled), and subprocessor list. If backups still contain data, we must disclose retention windows.
Mia (support): audit-bot produced an export id `audit-export-8432` for org `acme-2222` covering 2026-03-12T09:00 -> 2026-03-12T12:00. Link: https://intranet.internal/audit/exports/audit-export-8432 (internal only). Bundle contains deletion job events and billing diffs.
audit-bot: Export ready: audit-export-8432 — files: [events.ndjson, kms-events.ndjson, billing-diff.json]. Hash: sha256:ab3f...
Alex (security): quick verification from HSM logs: for key `rw-kms-eu-742a` at 2026-03-12T10:15:23Z there is an `ACCESS_DENIED` returned by our KMS proxy due to a transient ACL rule mismatch between connector and customer role. No scheduled deletion or key rotation occurred. KMS material remains under our control.
Alex (security): action items I will do: (1) provide HSM log snippet and explanation, (2) mark the connector ACL as fixed and redeploy, (3) add a guard to ensure deletion jobs don't enqueue re-ingest on KMS errors (create ticket INF-4217).
Sam (eng): I'll open a bug for the retry logic — if KMS returns deterministic access error we should move job to manual review, not retry ingestion. Created INF-4217. Assigning @Sam.
Mia (support): customer-facing message draft (short): "We've completed a deletion run for your account — deletion audit bundle is attached. Cause of 500 was transient KMS connector ACL error; we fixed the connector and prevented re-ingest. We will refund the accidental ingest charges and provide the subprocessor list and backup retention statement." Thoughts? :thumbsup:
Leah (legal): tweak: include explicit statement about backups: "Backups are retained for up to 30 days; we have processed the requested deletion for active and archival stores and will purge from backups according to our retention policy. Evidence attached." Also include subprocessor list CSV.
Mia (support): noted. I'll attach `audit-export-8432` and the subprocessor CSV. Sending now.
support-bot: message posted to customer (ticket #23781): "Deletion completed — evidence bundle attached. Refund initiated for accidental ingest charges. ETA for backup purge: 30 days."
Mia (support): closing loop here — Alex, can you paste the HSM snippet I should attach to the bundle (redact any internal IPs)?
Alex (security): paste below (redacted):
```
[2026-03-12T10:15:22Z] HSM TRACE key=rw-kms-eu-742a operation=Decrypt caller=kms-proxy-7 err=ACCESS_DENIED reason="missing connector role"
[2026-03-12T10:15:25Z] HSM TRACE key=rw-kms-eu-742a operation=Decrypt caller=kms-proxy-7 err=OK
```
Use that with the explanation: first attempt failed due to connector ACL, second attempt succeeded after connector redeploy which allowed the deletion job to finish. We will include ACL change log and ticket INF-4217.
Leah (legal): add a one-line attestation: "No key material was destroyed or exported; customer data was deleted from active/archival systems; backups will follow retention schedule."
Mia (support): perfect. I'll send final bundle + refund note. Thanks team :pray: 
Alex (security): leaving a follow-up: recommend a short runbook for SOC/oncall to handle KMS transient errors and to mark deletion jobs to manual review on access errors. I'll draft RFC next week.
Sam (eng): will add a metric to alert when deletion job retries >0 for same job id.
Mia (support): thread resolved from support side. If anything else pops up, re-open.
